subject: SOC2 re-attestation: evidence snapshot, retention tier split & capacity uplift discussion
messages:
From: Aurelia Systems - Security <security@aurelia.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Aurelia Systems - Procurement <procure@aurelia.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 08:45:00 +0100
Subject: SOC2 re-attestation for renewal — evidence & retention change request

Hi Olga,

As part of our upcoming renewal (targeting 2027-10-15), Security needs a refreshed SOC2 attestation and a consolidated evidence bundle. Two specific asks from our side:

1) Retention window: we are proposing splitting logs — 24 months for application-level telemetry and 36 months for audit logs. Please confirm feasibility and any additional costs.

2) Evidence snapshot: we need a self-contained manifest of artifacts (config exports, access logs, encryption key rotation records) and a lightweight index so our auditors can pull items during the 2-week review window.

Can you provide a proposed timeline and who on your side will own the evidence handoff? We will coordinate procurement/contract language with our legal team once scope and retention are agreed.

Thanks,
Mariana Alvarez
Head of Security
Aurelia Systems
[attachment: initial_evidence_requirements.pdf (pdf)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Aurelia Systems - Security <security@aurelia.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 11:12:00 +0100
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation for renewal — evidence & retention change request

Hi Mariana,

Thanks for the clear asks — we can support the split retention (24m app telemetry / 36m audit logs) but there is a short-term cost delta for extended cold storage on the audit logs. High-level plan from our side:

- Evidence manifest: we will assemble an "evidence_manifest_v2.xlsx" listing item-level artifacts, owners, and retrieval instructions.
- Timeline:
  * Draft manifest and checklist: by 2027-09-03 EOD (Olga)
  * Bulk evidence staging (S3/secure transfer): 2027-09-10 to 2027-09-12 (Ops lead Kimberly)
  * Auditor access window: 2027-09-20 to 2027-10-03
- Contract/terms: Ben will propose a short term amendment for retention horizon and the associated monthly uplift.

Action owners:
- Olga: manifest + single-point contact for auditor questions
- Kimberly: evidence staging & transfer; will prepare a transfer playbook describing formats and hashes
- Ben: commercial amendment language + pricing delta

We will attach the preliminary checklist and retention matrix for your review. If that sounds good I will loop in Ben's team to draft the amendment.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-soc2-evidence-checklist.csv (csv)]

From: Aurelia Systems - Procurement <procure@aurelia.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Aurelia Systems - Security <security@aurelia.com>, CarterLegal - Contracts <contracts@carterlegal.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 09:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation for renewal — evidence & retention change request

Hi Olga,

Thanks — procurement and legal looked at the proposed split and would prefer to see retention at 36 months across the board for auditability, and a separate clause that allows application telemetry to be pruned to 24 months at Aurora's (Aurelia's) discretion. That keeps the contract language simpler for our auditors.

Also: can you include a short note on how exported artifacts will be redacted for PII prior to transfer? Our legal counsel flagged data minimization and wants to be sure we won't get raw customer PII.

If you can update the manifest with a redaction column and a brief PII-handling note, we can move the contract team to prepare the amendment.

Cheers,
Toby Griffin
Procurement Manager
Aurelia Systems

>

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Aurelia Systems - Procurement <procure@aurelia.com>, Aurelia Systems - Security <security@aurelia.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 16:22:00 +0100
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation for renewal — evidence & retention change request

Toby / Mariana —

Appreciate the clarification. We can accommodate the contract language you suggested: 36 months default retention, with an application-telemetry carve-out at 24 months that requires a separate written request to trigger pruning. We'll document redaction handling in the manifest: redaction flag + recommended redaction step per artifact.

Next steps (agreed):
- I will upload "evidence_manifest_v2.xlsx" and "retention_proposal_matrix.pdf" to the shared drive by EOD 2027-09-03.
- Kimberly will prepare the transfer playbook and the PII redaction guidance.
- Ben will issue a one-page commercial amendment that covers the 36m default retention and the monthly storage uplift.

Ben — can you prepare an amendment draft and a high-level cost delta we can preview for Aurelia procurement (deal DL-9921)? I will include the Drive link in the HubSpot deal.

Thanks — will follow up after uploads.

Best regards,
Olga Petrov
Senior Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
[attachment: retention_proposal_matrix.pdf (pdf)]
